mod.name: ESL-MOD
mod.ruleset: competitive Search & Destroy - no perks, no killstreaks, no deathstreaks

source.read_from: the tweaked payload - the same numbers the match uses

units.damage: per-shot damage; min is the value at the end of the drop curve
units.range_meters: distance in metres; 'full' is where max damage ends, 'min' where it reaches minDamage
units.multipliers: per-hit-location damage multiplier (missing limbs default to 1.0)
units.recoil_center_speed: higher is less recoil (the engine divides the view kick by it)
units.ads_move_speed_scale: multiplier on the movement speed while aiming
units.esl_changed: {dvar: final value} for every parameter ESL set on that weapon
